comment: Word stems that a newcomer to software supply-chain security is unlikely
to know on first read. Each stem is matched case-insensitively with a
trailing wildcard, so 'delegat' covers delegate, delegated and delegation.
This list measures how much specialist vocabulary a page asks the reader to
absorb. A high density is not automatically wrong — the specification pages
need these words — but on introductory pages it is a strong signal that the
page assumes knowledge the reader does not have yet.
